Build an interactive 2D figure from the brief below and the source image.

AUTHORED FIGURE BRIEF:
This figure is part of a worked example asking to evaluate the polar double integral of sin theta over the region R in the first quadrant outside the circle r = 2 and inside the cardioid r = 2(1 + cos theta). The figure shows both curves in polar coordinates: the circle r = 2 (blue) centered at the origin and the cardioid r = 2(1 + cos theta) (purple), which extends further to the right. The shaded region R (light blue) lies in the first quadrant between theta = 0 and theta = pi/2, bounded on the inside by the circle and on the outside by the cardioid; a red radial line at an intermediate angle shows a representative radial strip. The figure establishes the geometry of the integration region R needed to set up the polar iterated integral with inner limits from r = 2 to r = 2(1 + cos theta) and outer limits from theta = 0 to theta = pi/2.

REQUESTED INTERACTIONS:
- equation input for the cardioid boundary: one field pre-filled with "2*(1+cos(theta))"; learner edits r=f(θ) and the curve redraws alongside the fixed circle r=2, the shaded integration region updates, and the intersection angle recomputes — shows how the curve formula determines where the two boundaries meet and the size of the region
- slider for θ from 0 to π/2: sweep the radial line tracing the boundary between the two curves and shading the enclosed region

SOURCE FILE: Anton, Bivens, and Davis. Calculus, 10th Edition, Figure 14.3.10

There is no blueprint: decide the figure type, elements, labels, controls, and any step sequence yourself.

var xDomain = [-3.0, 4.7]; var yDomain = [-2.85, 3.15]; var frame = setPlotFrame({ xDomain: xDomain, yDomain: yDomain, margin: 18, draw: draw }); var defaultExpr = '2*(1+cos(theta))'; var cardioidFn = compileExpr(defaultExpr, ['theta']); var cardioidSrc = defaultExpr; var currentTheta = Math.PI / 4; function pointsAttrLocal(points) { return points.map(function (p) { return p[0] + ',' + p[1]; }).join(' '); } function polarPoint(theta, r) { return [plotX(r * Math.cos(theta)), plotY(r * Math.sin(theta))]; } function safeR(fn, theta) { var v; try { v = fn(theta); } catch (e) { return NaN; } return (typeof v === 'number' && isFinite(v)) ? v : NaN; } function isDefaultCardioidText(src) { return String(src).replace(/\s+/g, '') === defaultExpr.replace(/\s+/g, ''); } function formatAngle(t) { if (!isFinite(t)) return '—'; if (Math.abs(t) < 0.006) return '0'; if (Math.abs(t - Math.PI / 6) < 0.006) return 'π/6'; if (Math.abs(t - Math.PI / 4) < 0.006) return 'π/4'; if (Math.abs(t - Math.PI / 3) < 0.006) return 'π/3'; if (Math.abs(t - Math.PI / 2) < 0.006) return 'π/2'; return t.toFixed(2); } function findQuadrantIntersections(fn) { var a = 0, b = Math.PI / 2, n = 220, eps = 1e-6; var roots = []; var prevT = a, prevG = safeR(fn, a) - 2; function addRoot(r) { if (!isFinite(r) || r < a - 1e-6 || r > b + 1e-6) return; for (var k = 0; k < roots.length; k++) { if (Math.abs(roots[k] - r) < 0.004) return; } roots.push(Math.max(a, Math.min(b, r))); } if (isFinite(prevG) && Math.abs(prevG) < eps) addRoot(a); for (var i = 1; i <= n; i++) { var t = a + (b - a) * i / n; var g = safeR(fn, t) - 2; if (isFinite(g) && isFinite(prevG)) { if (Math.abs(g) < eps) addRoot(t); if (prevG * g < 0) { var root = findRoot(function (u) { return safeR(fn, u) - 2; }, prevT, t, 1e-9); if (root != null) addRoot(root); } } prevT = t; prevG = g; } roots.sort(function (u, v) { return u - v; }); return roots; } function shadeIntervals(fn) { var a = 0, b = Math.PI / 2, n = 180; var intervals = []; var outer = [], inner = []; function flush() { if (outer.length >= 2) intervals.push({ outer: outer.slice(), inner: inner.slice() }); outer = []; inner = []; } for (var i = 0; i <= n; i++) { var t = a + (b - a) * i / n; var r = safeR(fn, t); if (isFinite(r) && r >= 2) { outer.push(polarPoint(t, r)); inner.push(polarPoint(t, 2)); } else { flush(); } } flush(); return intervals; } function samplePolarCurve(fn, a, b, n) { var segs = [], cur = []; for (var i = 0; i <= n; i++) { var t = a + (b - a) * i / n; var r = safeR(fn, t); if (isFinite(r)) { cur.push(polarPoint(t, r)); } else if (cur.length) { segs.push(cur); cur = []; } } if (cur.length) segs.push(cur); return segs; } function addMathLabel(text, wx, wy, fs, color, anchor) { var t = draw.text(text) .font({ family: 'Georgia, Times New Roman, serif', size: fs, weight: 400 }) .attr({ fill: color || '#222222', 'font-style': 'italic', 'paint-order': 'stroke', stroke: '#ffffff', 'stroke-width': Math.max(3, fs * 0.16), 'stroke-linejoin': 'round' }); if (anchor) t.attr({ 'text-anchor': anchor }); t.move(plotX(wx), plotY(wy)); return t; } function attachInfo(el, tip, title, body) { el.css('cursor', 'pointer'); el.on('mousemove', function (e) { showTooltip(tip, e); }); el.on('mouseleave', function () { hideTooltip(); }); el.on('click', function () { showPopup(title, body); }); } function updateReadouts(roots) { var intersection = document.getElementById('intersectionVal'); var strip = document.getElementById('stripVal'); var area = document.getElementById('areaVal'); var thetaOut = document.getElementById('thetaVal'); if (thetaOut) thetaOut.textContent = formatAngle(currentTheta); if (intersection) { if (roots.length) intersection.textContent = roots.map(formatAngle).join(', '); else intersection.textContent = 'none in [0, π/2]'; } var rNow = safeR(cardioidFn, currentTheta); if (strip) { if (isFinite(rNow) && rNow >= 2) { strip.textContent = '2 ≤ r ≤ ' + rNow.toFixed(2); } else if (isFinite(rNow)) { strip.textContent = 'none here; f(θ) = ' + rNow.toFixed(2) + ' < 2'; } else { strip.textContent = 'undefined at this θ'; } } if (area) { var A = integrateSimpson(function (t) { var r = safeR(cardioidFn, t); if (!isFinite(r) || r < 2) return 0; return 0.5 * (r * r - 4); }, 0, Math.PI / 2, 500); area.textContent = isFinite(A) ? A.toFixed(3) : '—'; } } function renderFigure() { draw.clear(); var s = Math.max(1, Math.min(frame.width, frame.height)); var axisW = Math.max(1.7, Math.min(3.4, s * 0.0042)); var curveW = Math.max(3.2, Math.min(6.5, s * 0.009)); var redW = Math.max(2.5, Math.min(5.0, s * 0.007)); var fs = Math.max(17, Math.min(34, s * 0.055)); var blue = '#2aa0d8'; var purple = '#b762ad'; var fillBlue = '#c6e4ef'; var red = '#ef5a5f'; var axis = '#222222'; var roots = findQuadrantIntersections(cardioidFn); var intervals = shadeIntervals(cardioidFn); for (var q = 0; q < intervals.length; q++) { var polyPts = intervals[q].outer.concat(intervals[q].inner.slice().reverse()); if (polyPts.length >= 3) { var region = draw.polygon(pointsAttrLocal(polyPts)) .fill({ color: fillBlue, opacity: 0.88 }) .stroke('none'); attachInfo( region, 'Region R: outside r=2 and inside the purple curve in the first quadrant.', 'Polar integration region', 'Each radial slice starts at the circle r = 2 and ends at the outer boundary r = f(θ). For the textbook curve, θ runs from 0 to π/2, so the integral uses 2 ≤ r ≤ 2(1 + cos θ).' ); } } draw.line(plotX(xDomain[0]), plotY(0), plotX(xDomain[1]), plotY(0)) .stroke({ color: axis, width: axisW, linecap: 'square' }); draw.line(plotX(0), plotY(yDomain[0]), plotX(0), plotY(yDomain[1])) .stroke({ color: axis, width: axisW, linecap: 'square' }); var rLine = safeR(cardioidFn, currentTheta); var lineEnd = isFinite(rLine) ? rLine : 2; var radialEnd = polarPoint(currentTheta, lineEnd); var radial = draw.line(plotX(0), plotY(0), radialEnd[0], radialEnd[1]) .stroke({ color: red, width: redW, linecap: 'round' }); attachInfo( radial, 'Representative radial strip at θ = ' + formatAngle(currentTheta) + '.', 'A radial strip', 'Holding θ fixed turns the two polar curves into inner and outer radial limits. The slider sweeps that strip through the first quadrant.' ); var circleSegs = samplePolarCurve(function () { return 2; }, 0, 2 * Math.PI, 360); for (var c = 0; c < circleSegs.length; c++) { var circle = draw.polyline(pointsAttrLocal(circleSegs[c])) .fill('none') .stroke({ color: blue, width: curveW, linecap: 'round', linejoin: 'round' }); attachInfo(circle, 'Fixed inner boundary: r = 2.', 'Circle r = 2', 'This circle supplies the lower radial limit r = 2 wherever the shaded region exists.'); } var cardSegs = samplePolarCurve(cardioidFn, 0, 2 * Math.PI, 540); for (var p = 0; p < cardSegs.length; p++) { if (cardSegs[p].length > 1) { var card = draw.polyline(pointsAttrLocal(cardSegs[p])) .fill('none') .stroke({ color: purple, width: curveW, linecap: 'round', linejoin: 'round' }); attachInfo(card, 'Editable outer boundary: r = f(θ).', 'Cardioid boundary', 'Changing the formula redraws this polar curve and recomputes the part of the first quadrant lying outside the circle.'); } } addMathLabel('θ = π/2', -1.40, 2.72, fs * 1.05, '#222222'); addMathLabel('r = 2', -2.74, 1.38, fs * 0.95, '#222222'); addMathLabel(isDefaultCardioidText(cardioidSrc) ? 'r = 2(1 + cos θ)' : 'r = f(θ)', 1.55, 2.98, fs * 0.98, '#222222'); addMathLabel('θ = 0', 2.48, -0.16, fs * 0.95, '#222222'); updateReadouts(roots); } function update_theta(v) { currentTheta = Math.max(0, Math.min(Math.PI / 2, v)); renderFigure(); } bindEquationInput('cardioidInput', function (fn, src) { cardioidFn = fn; cardioidSrc = src; renderFigure(); }, { variables: ['theta'] }); document.addEventListener('fig-resize', function () { renderFigure(); }); renderFigure(); window.__markRendered(); // @FIGURE_CODE_END
